summary: QV.23.100 is a qualitative design and decision summary for Corvenlith Therapeutics, not a numerical differential-expression export. Donor balancing reduced the apparent inflammatory signature and redirected work towards the reproducible receptor pathway. Exact contrasts, pathway identifiers and statistical methods remain in the engagement analysis records; no fold changes, adjusted probabilities or numerical ranking are reconstructed here.
